skill.name: alan-test-feature
skill.description: Plan and execute browser feature tests, capture evidence, upload media, and create a structured Alan test report.
skill.summary: Run scoped browser tests and publish evidence-backed feature reports in Alan.
skill.author: supatest-ai

security_audit.summary: Most backtick, localhost, device-file, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives caused by Markdown examples or bounded local testing. Confirmed risks include unpinned global installation, repository script execution, environment-file access, predictable temporary storage, and mandatory capture uploads. Media can contain credentials or private application data and is uploaded without a review gate.

remediation.issue: Mandatory screenshot and video uploads can disclose sensitive application data.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit approval before upload, preview every capture, redact secrets and personal data, and support a local-only report mode.

remediation.issue: The workflow reads .env and .env.local while discovering the application port.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer server output and public configuration. If needed, parse only allowlisted port keys without exposing complete environment files.

remediation.issue: The skill globally installs an unpinned npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin an audited agent-browser version, verify package integrity, and require user confirmation before installation.

remediation.issue: The skill starts repository-defined scripts and services.
remediation.suggestion: Show the resolved command, inspect its definition, and request confirmation before executing project startup code.

remediation.issue: Capture files use predictable paths in a shared temporary directory.
remediation.suggestion: Create a private temporary directory with restrictive permissions, reject symlinks, and remove captures after reporting.

content.user_title: Test Features and Publish Evidence Reports
content.value_statement: Manual feature testing can miss edge cases and leave evidence scattered. This skill plans browser scenarios, captures results, uploads media, and creates a structured Alan report.
actual_capabilities: Reviews branch history and diffs to identify affected features.
Scopes light, standard, or comprehensive coverage with the user.
Builds explicit scenarios for happy paths, errors, and edge cases.
Runs browser interactions through the agent-browser command-line tool.
Captures screenshots and short WebM recordings during tests.
Uploads evidence and creates a structured report through Alan MCP tools.
limitations: Requires agent-browser and a runnable local development server.
Requires Alan MCP tools and upload access for complete reports.
Screenshots and recordings may include sensitive application data.
Does not replace unit, integration, performance, or security testing.

use_cases.title: Validate a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Test changed user flows before review and attach visual evidence to a structured report.

use_cases.title: Verify Acceptance Criteria
use_cases.description: Run agreed scenarios and document passes, failures, and reproducible defects for a feature.

use_cases.title: Review a Release Candidate
use_cases.description: Check critical workflows, edge cases, responsiveness, and navigation before a release decision.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Light Feature Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Test the current feature with light coverage. Confirm the main path, capture required evidence, and create the Alan test report.
prompt_templates.scenario: A quick smoke test for a small change.

prompt_templates.title: Run Standard Feature Testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Test [feature] with standard coverage. Include the happy path, validation failures, key error states, and a structured report.

prompt_templates.title: Run Comprehensive Browser Testing
prompt_templates.prompt: Test [feature] comprehensively. Cover boundaries, permissions, responsiveness, navigation, and recoverable failures. Record separate videos when needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Broad release validation for a user-facing feature.

prompt_templates.title: Design Risk-Based Change Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze changes between [base branch] and HEAD. Design risk-based scenarios for [feature], execute them, and report reproducible defects with evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced testing across a complex branch.

output_examples.input: Test the new account settings form with standard coverage.
output_examples.output: A mixed-status report covers saving valid changes, required-field validation, duplicate submission, and server failure. Two reproducible issues include screenshot evidence.

output_examples.input: Run a light check of the updated checkout confirmation page.
output_examples.output: A passing report documents navigation, purchase confirmation, persisted order details, and final visual evidence.

output_examples.input: Test the dashboard comprehensively on desktop and mobile widths.
output_examples.output: A comprehensive report summarizes responsive layouts, empty states, authorization behavior, navigation, and recoverable API failures with linked media.

best_practices: Provide acceptance criteria, test accounts, and known risks before execution.
Review captures for secrets and personal data before approving uploads.
Use stable test data and isolate tests from production systems.
anti_patterns: Do not provide production credentials or unrestricted administrative accounts.
Do not upload captures before checking visible data and browser state.
Do not treat browser testing as complete security or regression coverage.

faq.question: What coverage levels are supported?
faq.answer: Light covers the main path. Standard adds key edge cases and errors. Comprehensive adds boundaries, responsiveness, navigation, and broader failure states.

faq.question: Does the skill start the application?
faq.answer: Yes. It inspects common project files, selects a likely development command, starts the server, and checks its local port.

faq.question: Which browser tool does it use?
faq.answer: It uses the agent-browser command-line tool for navigation, interaction, screenshots, and recording.

faq.question: Are screenshots and videos required?
faq.answer: The current workflow requires screenshots and attempts video recording. Users should review media before any external upload.

faq.question: Where is the final report created?
faq.answer: The skill calls the Alan report tool to create a structured artifact linked to the active task, conversation, and team.

faq.question: Can it test production systems?
faq.answer: The workflow targets a local development server. Production testing requires separate authorization, data controls, and operational safeguards.
